headline: Argentina Cuts Public Spending by Nearly 10% in October Under Caputo
summary: Economy Minister Luis Caputo deepened fiscal adjustments, cutting public spending by nearly 10% in October, with provincial governments and universities among the hardest hit.
why: Aggressive fiscal consolidation is a core element of Argentina's stabilization program aimed at achieving a primary fiscal surplus and curbing inflation.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Sharp expenditure cuts improve fiscal metrics, aligning with broader debt-sustainability goals watched by sovereign debt investors.
